purpose: Independent named native turbine solid regions for a shared gas model, preserving existing fork.14 single-wall behavior and lifecycle.

source.scope: FGTurbine generic named optional solids, one shared bounded solver, atomic candidate validation, per-solid persistent state and initial conditions; native tests/docs and SDK version only.

toolchain.emscripten: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.9-git

thermal.configuration: Existing flat wall retained. Optional solid-region elements add named independent solids using the same required SI wall fields. Optional gas-temperature-k selects each solid bath; defaults to nozzle gas.
thermal.state: All solids evaluate into preallocated candidate state once per native calculation and commit only after every region validates. Accepted positive non-trim, non-suspended native simulation time only; independent exact restoration and one-shot warm/cold initialization.
thermal.f135Selection: Two useful solids: retained cooled downstream liner plus upstream core-facing hardware; no third petal state.

nativeThermal.scope: All fifteen fork.14 temperature/lifecycle/convergence/heat-balance cases and five new cases covering separate regions/indexed properties, suspension/trim/reset restoration, AB bath isolation, all-or-none invalid-input retention and safe region name/config rejection.

sdkBuild.scope: Clean frozen source, locked toolchain, mandatory native WASM/TypeScript/SDK tests. No browser/GPU checks.

fullApplicationCi.scope: Related app checks, eleven installed real-WASM thermal lifecycle scenarios and full CI once passed. Late intake mesh closure passed all affected checks and a final production build, recorded in combined acceptance.

installedThermalLifecycle.scope: Both solids cold/warm/AB/dry/shutdown, read/hold/zero-time/trim, independent native state, actual app snapshot/reset/reload/free/runway relocation and stopped engine stand relocation, full powered-lift transient without AB.
installedThermalLifecycle.retainedHarnessCorrection: Stopped-hot scenario initially omitted holdDown true and invoked flight preset; corrected single argument, reran only that case, retained all evidence.

preservation.previousArtifact: Immutable fork.14 tarball retained. No accepted archive overwritten.
preservation.matchingEngineData: Prior single-solid F135 XML retained with declaration/lock/identity before adoption.
preservation.unrelatedWorkingTree: 0sfs unrelated dirty work preserved; JSBSim was clean before this change.

limitations: The F135 core and liner capacities/cooling/areas are explicit provisional data, not measured F135 station or material calibration.
No inter-solid conduction or full engine-cycle feedback is modeled.
Per-solid gas baths can isolate upstream hardware from AB; base EGT remains the existing native schedule.
Bolometric emissivity is independent of renderer spectral emissivity.
Actual installed app lifecycle acceptance and full CI belong to the combined reconstruction record; native/SDK success alone does not qualify visuals.
No push, upstream submission, npm publication, GPU qualification or timing/energy claim.
